# Vendored assets

These files are inlined into `docs/index.html` by `website/build/build_site.py` so the page works offline.

| File | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `d3.v7.9.0.min.js` | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/d3/7.9.0/d3.min.js | ISC, © 2010–2023 Mike Bostock |
| `fonts/IBMPlexMono-*.woff2` | Google Fonts, latin subset | SIL OFL 1.1, see `fonts/OFL-ibmplexmono.txt` |
| `fonts/Newsreader-*.woff2` | Google Fonts, latin subset | SIL OFL 1.1, see `fonts/OFL-newsreader.txt` |
| `fonts/SchibstedGrotesk-*.woff2` | Google Fonts, latin subset | SIL OFL 1.1, see `fonts/OFL-schibstedgrotesk.txt` |

`fonts/fonts.json` lists each font file with its family, style, weight range and original download URL.
